groups_name.name: groups_name
groups_name.value: ("groups"."kind" = 'direct' AND "groups"."name" IS NULL) OR ("groups"."kind" = 'group' AND "groups"."name" IS NOT NULL AND length("groups"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 60)

transactions_type_fields.name: transactions_type_fields
transactions_type_fields.value:
("transactions"."type" = 'expense' AND "transactions"."split_method" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."payment_method" IS NULL AND "transactions"."payment_ref" IS NULL)
       OR ("transactions"."type" = 'settlement' AND "transactions"."split_method" IS NULL AND "transactions"."split_input" IS NULL AND "transactions"."payment_method" IS NOT NULL)
